item.title: What's driving Israel's stock market?
item.description: After two boom years, the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange continues to be one of the world's best performing markets. What lies behind the phenomenon, and can it continue?

item.title: “Rate below NIS 3/$ will happen faster than we think”
item.description: As the shekel hits a new four-year strongest against the US dollar, analysts see the Israeli currency continuing to appreciate.

item.title: Leumi buys 20% stake in Delek Israel ahead of Hot acquisition
item.description: Leumi Partners will take a 20% stake in Delek Israel at a company valuation of NIS 1 billion, after money, a source close to the deal has said.

item.title: TASE eyes major Israeli cos traded only on Wall Street
item.description: The listing of Palo Alto Networks on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange could pave the way for the likes of Check Point, Wix and others.

item.title: Startup Nation Central laying off most employees
item.description: SNC interim CEO Aviva Steinberger: By sharpening our focus and aligning resources with today’s most strategic needs, we will continue to serve the ecosystem in meaningful and impactful ways.

item.title: Israeli cabinet approves two new int’l airports
item.description: In contradiction to Transport Minister Miri Regev’s decision that a new airport be built in Ziklag in the Negev, the cabinet has kept open the option of Ramat David in the north.

item.title: India agrees arms deals with Israel worth $8.6b - report
item.description: The deals include SPICE 1000 precision guidance bombs, Rampage air-to-surface missiles, Air Lora air-launched ballistic missiles, and the Ice Breaker missile system, “Forbes India” reports.

item.title: ZIM's Israeli workers strike following sale report
item.description: Talks broke down today between the workers and the ZIM board over reported sale of the company to Hapag-Lloyd and private equity firm FIMI.

item.title: Hapag-Lloyd, FIMI to acquire ZIM for over $3b
item.description: The deal will be structured so that the German shipping giant will buy the international operations of ZIM, while FIMI will acquire the Israeli operations, in which the state has a golden share.

item.title: Annual inflation in Israel falls below 2%
item.description: Inflation in Israel is at its lowest rate since 2021, after the January Consumer Price Index fell more heavily than expected, but home prices continued to rise.
